s0.title: First, choose a topic
s0.copy: Choose the topic of the five words your opponent will have to guess. Try selecting one here before continuing.

s1.title: Write five words
s1.copy: Each box holds one word for your opponent. You can write your own: use different words of 3–12 letters recognized in the selected topic’s dictionary.

s2.title: Let the game fill the words
s2.copy: If you prefer, use the button to choose words for you. The game fills the five boxes with words from your topic. Tap again to try others, or edit the suggestions.

s3.title: Keep your favorites
s3.copy: Tap the pin beside a valid word to keep it. Pinned words stay when you choose words automatically again. Tap the pin again to release them. Changing the topic also releases words.

s4.title: You have 90 seconds
s4.copy: In an online match you have 90 seconds to prepare and send your words. When time runs out, valid words are kept, missing words are filled and they are sent automatically. This clock is just an example: no opponent is waiting.
